title: Who still holds r1?
description: Change a team convention and compare what a fresh run and an already-active run each receive.
initialCaption: The repository, the stored record and the active run all say “npm test” at r1. Change the convention and watch who still holds r1.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: When the repository’s test command changes from r1 to r2, a stored record still says r1. A fresh run that checks the record’s revision rejects it and reads r2; an active run keeps r1 until its context is refreshed.
